This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="LF" /> [[Deesh Crozli]] was a member of this species.<ref name="VG" />

==Biology and appearance==
This diminutive [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]<ref name="LF" /> was distinguished by their unique metallic [[pressure-mask]]s attached to a [[gas mixture monitor]]s on their chests.<ref name="VG" /> These [[Helmet|masks]] had an almost organic appearance, featuring a defined [[nose]] and other detailed faux facial features, as well as bright orange lenses over the [[eye]]s and a translucent orange bulb extending from the [[mouth]]-area.<ref name="LF" /> The masks and monitors periodically immersed the species in an [[Atmosphere|atmospheric]] mixture that matched that of their [[Deesh Crozli's homeworld|homeworld]], required to protect their soft tissue.<ref name="VG" /> They also spoke in an [[alien]] [[language]].<ref name="LF" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> [[Deesh Crozli]],<ref name="VG" /> a member of this species was present on the [[planet]] [[Ueda]], having pointed the [[assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae Aniseya]] towards [[Mae's quest|her target]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]], in exchange for [[Galactic Credit Standard|payment]].<ref name="LF" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species made their debut in the [[Lost / Found|first episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by the series' creator [[Leslye Headland]].<ref name="LF" /> They were designed by concept artist [[Ivan Manzella]].<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creatures & Character Designs|author=Manzella, Ivan|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20190121223617}}</ref>
